title: Preserve Skill identity in authorization events
goal: Keep skillID attached to actionAuthorized events so the M6 audit trail can link proposal, authorization, execution, and observation for Skills.
context: M6 includes skillID in actionProposed, actionExecuted, and observationProduced, but actionAuthorized only copies toolID from ActionIntent. Since Skill proposals have no toolID, the authorization event loses the Skill identity.
forbidden_changes: Do not change policy decisions or capabilities.
Do not fabricate toolID for Skill proposals.
Do not emit authorization for a denied or unapproved action.
acceptance_criteria: A successfully authorized Skill emits actionAuthorized with its skillID and actionID.
The authorization actionID matches actionExecuted and observationProduced.
Denied Skills remain fail-closed and are not marked authorized.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Add only the missing skillID metadata and regression assertion; preserve authorization boundaries.
